property_summary: Non-admin callers always revert when attempting to create a new emergency oracle
Only an admin can successfully create a new EmergencyOracle via newEmergencyOracle.
A call to newEmergencyOracle succeeds iff the caller is an admin.
After a call to newEmergencyOracle, the owner of the deployed EmergencyOracle must be msg.sender (the caller), but the mutant sets owner to address(0).
